description: React component for displaying and managing a table of jobs in the Mattermost admin console, including pagination, job actions, and rendering job details.

classes.name: JobTable
classes.description: React component class for rendering a table of jobs with pagination, actions, and details.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches jobs by type and sets up periodic reload.

methods.name: getExtraInfoText
methods.description: Returns extra info text or error message for a job.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the list of jobs by type.

methods.name: handleCancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job and reloads the list.

methods.name: handleCreateJob
methods.description: Creates a new job and reloads the list.

methods.name: handleNextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of jobs.

methods.name: handlePrevPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of jobs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the job table with pagination, buttons, and job details.
